style: Joseon-era Korean ink-and-wash painting with muted mineral colors (ink black, faded indigo, ochre, dull vermilion), visible brush texture on aged hanji paper, mysterious and slightly eerie atmosphere with dramatic soft lighting, cinematic composition, no anime, no modern objects.

characters.TOJEONG: Joseon scholar-eccentric in his forties, lean face, sharp knowing eyes, thin black mustache and short beard, wearing a worn wide straw hat and a plain undyed ramie robe, wooden clogs
characters.BROTHER: Joseon scholar in his fifties, gentle dignified face, grey beard, white dopo robe and black gat hat
characters.FATHER: elderly Joseon gentleman in his seventies, white hair and long white beard, ivory robe, sitting on a floor cushion
characters.HWADAM: elderly hermit scholar with long white beard and hair tied in a topknot, simple white robe, serene wise face
characters.YULGOK: refined Joseon scholar-official in his late thirties, calm intelligent face, neat black beard, light blue dopo robe and black gat
characters.NEPHEW: Joseon high official in his thirties in a deep red official robe and black winged hat
characters.BOY: bright-eyed Joseon boy of about twelve with his hair in a braid, white hanbok
characters.BEGGAR CHILDREN: three thin ragged Joseon beggar children shivering in the snow
characters.SON: Joseon righteous-army leader in his thirties wearing simple leather armor and a black hat, holding a sword
characters.OFFICIALS: Joseon royal secretariat officials in red robes with black winged hats
characters.VILLAGERS: Joseon commoners in plain off-white hanbok, some with straw hats or headscarves, farmers, fishermen and women
